title: Remediate Item 4 deterministic risk and verification-policy Spec drift
description: Close post-merge Spec v3.1 gaps discovered while preparing Item 5: deterministic task-risk detection/detected_risk output and five-source Verification Policy minimum checks with Reviewer/QA add-only semantics.
incident_reason: Post-merge direct Spec v3.1 re-read found Item 4 implemented risk-level gates but not the full deterministic task-risk detection output or all §12 minimum-check sources.

acceptance_criteria.description: Risk Classifier accepts changed/requested paths, Project Map sensitive zones and deterministic task-risk rules with no LLM contribution to deterministic calculations.
Classifier outputs risk_floor and detected_risk, computes pre-manager risk as MAX(detected_risk,risk_floor), then permits Manager only to keep or escalate.
Verification Policy deterministically derives minimum applicable checks from risk level, changed file types, changed modules, sensitive zones and mandatory Task Contract acceptance criteria.
Reviewer/QA additions are additive; deterministic required checks cannot be removed, and disagreement over non-required removal is surfaced for Manager decision with deterministic evidence.
NOT_EXECUTED never satisfies any deterministic or reviewer-added required check.
Existing Item 4 behavior and Q-1/Q-2/Q-3 regressions remain green.
PR changes exactly the three remediation write-scope files and no forbidden path.
